scope.summary: A forced server error and a forced client error are both reported to the error-monitoring service (Sentry protocol) with the release tag.

interface.server_error: GET /debug/server-error raises an unhandled server-side exception (HTTP 500). Available when APP_ENV is not "production".
interface.client_error: GET /debug/client-error shows a button "Trigger client error" that throws an unhandled JavaScript error in the browser. Available when APP_ENV is not "production".
interface.ingest: SENTRY_DSN / PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN point at a Sentry-protocol ingest (store or envelope endpoint).

criteria.then: within 20 s the ingest receives an error event with exception information, release = APP_RELEASE and environment = APP_ENV

criteria.when: a browser opens /debug/client-error and presses "Trigger client error"
criteria.then: within 20 s the ingest receives an error event sent by the browser SDK with exception information and release = APP_RELEASE
